notes.title: Graphics Option Patch
notes.notes:
Hello all,

Thank you to everyone who has played and supported this game!

We have an update here containing some options that can help optimize Perfect Vermin which we think will help a lot of users who have trouble running the game.

[b]Changes[/b]
      [list]
      [*] Added 3D resolution, anti aliasing, post processing quality, shadow quality, texture quality, and 
           effect quality graphic options.
      [*] Updated credits.
      [/list]

notes.title: Perfect Vermin Speedrunner's Edition
notes.notes:
Hey! 

Angad and I have received a few messages asking about a possible RNG lite version of Perfect Vermin as the game's randomness can lead to many speed runs being dead on arrival due to unfortunate furniture placement.

So we are introducing [b]Perfect Vermin: Terminal Velocity Edition![/b] This optional version of Perfect Vermin features set furniture placements allowing speedrunners to get consistent spawns run after run. (Note: Achievements are disabled in this version of the game)

To access Perfect Vermin: Terminal Velocity Edition, navigate to Perfect Vermin in your Steam library and right click on it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38956799/15cad2b3b4ef2df54dc831f27535032abad480db.png[/img]

Then navigate the dropdown and select "Properties"

Once "Properties" has been selected, navigate this menu to the "Betas" tab.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38956799/983c252c25d45015cec01e30c5c81f851385a916.png[/img]

Then select Terminal Velocity Edition and you should be all set!

-Maceo (Perfect Vermin's Designer and Artist)
